primary.title: PPF for children: Can both parents contribute to the account and claim tax deductions?
primary.summary: PPF is a long-term savings scheme with tax benefits. Parents can open a PPF account for minors, but total contributions by both parents cannot exceed ₹1.5 lakh annually. Details here.
